scopeLimits: No UI mounting, gestures, focus, animation, device calls, build, or test execution.
GlobalContext success path requires a real UIAbilityContext and is excluded.
HighlyLoaded.MonthDataSource.setData has an empty production body and is excluded.
SecondaryLinkage short batches below ten are excluded because production reads ten entries without bounds checks.
Production modules contain existing console.info calls; test code introduces no console logging.
